Review and submit

/courses/:courseId/assignments/:assignmentId/review
Roles: studentScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S07

Review the exact prepared attempt and make one explicit submission decision. Receipt status changes only after acknowledgement, with safe recovery when an outcome is unknown.

Keep reviewingSubmit attempt
Permissions
  • Commit requires current enrollment, allowed attempt and personal timing checks.
  • One group member may submit only under published group policy and reviewed membership.
  • Staff/learner preview cannot produce real or simulated learner receipts silently.
Responsive
  • Review list precedes final commit panel; button stays reachable without covering content.
  • Group members wrap into a list; no clipped names or counts.
Accessibility
  • Final confirmation has accessible title and focus return on cancellation.
  • Errors link to specific pages/fields; sending and acknowledgement announce distinct statuses.
Data
  • Reviewed payload fingerprint, ordered item references, target/membership version.
  • Submission operation reference and acknowledgement outcome; no mutable receipt copy.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Double-click Submit yields one acknowledged attempt in the fixture.
  • A timeout cannot create a success receipt until status resolution confirms it.
  • Changing page order or group membership clears confirmation and requires fresh review.
  • A late attempt after personal due but before personal close can be received and labeled Late; at/after close the page offers a scoped request/recovery instead of fake success.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
